scope: Research only: STACK/Amazon Caddo Parish / State Line Road / Blanchard campus. Neither admitted Bossier Highway 3 Technology Park nor Resilient Technology Park in west Shreveport is a proposed addition here.

candidate.name: STACK Caddo State Line Blanchard Campus
candidate.single_site_guardrail: One potential campus only; no separate building, phase, utility, acreage holding or program row is counted.

lifecycle.date_semantics: Release dateline normalizes a contemporary physical-status statement; not an independently dated site inspection or retrieval date.
lifecycle.finding: STACK explicitly states construction is already underway at its Caddo and Bossier campuses. The Caddo member passes the temporal/physical screen, but the broad statement does not resolve a parcel.
lifecycle.short_quote: With construction already underway at its planned campuses in Caddo and Bossier Parishes
lifecycle.body_anchor: Paragraph beginning STACK is putting its commitment to Northwest Louisiana into action.
lifecycle.unselected: No finer phase, capacity, operating model, workload, tenant role or imagery observation. No status is inferred from incentives, permitting or future jobs.

identity_and_geometry.reason: No reviewed source-specific locator, georeferenced campus plan, site boundary, survey or exact parcel bridge was established. CRS, precision and accuracy are unavailable, not borrowed from Bossier.

facts.authority: secondary local reporting, including attributed NLEP statements
facts.finding: KSLA identifies the announced Amazon campus north of Blanchard Latex Road on State Line Road, separately from the west-Highway-3 campus and from the third Resilient Tech Park proposal. This is a road-level identity lead, not geometry.

Commission/administration remarks identify a State Line Road data center in unincorporated Caddo, outside the parish planning area. They also record an outstanding request concerning its permits. No parcel, applicant name, datum or boundary is supplied.

Resolution 11 authorizes execution of a water-services agreement, but calls the customer only Prospective Customer. No executed agreement or property exhibit is attached. The unrelated annexation petitions on page 2 must not be used as the campus.

applicant_leads_not_primary_verified.finding: Shreveport Times reporting syndication describes SAC III Acquisition Co. LLC purchases at Blanchard Latex/State Line and STACK executives on the transaction. Leads to deed/parcel retrieval only; reported acreage, office-address similarity and executive identity do not independently certify campus geometry.
Reporting names TXLAAR LLC as the water-agreement counterparty. The published municipal authorization does not itself corroborate that name.

corps_search.method: Captured full public index and searched text for Caddo, Blanchard, State Line, Stateline, TXLAAR, SAC III, STACK, campus, data center, technology and Bohler; reviewed every relevant hit.
corps_search.result: No Caddo State Line campus permit/map found. MVK-2025-00855 is explicitly Bossier and is excluded. Recent Caddo entries concerning lake recreation/drainage (MVK-2025-00393) and a Racetrac store (MVK-2025-00692) are unrelated.
corps_search.limitation: Negative indexed-notice search is not proof of no permit. A general permit, unpublished site plan or other public record could exist. No guessed Caddo permit ID or Bossier georeference is selected.

rejected_fallbacks: Aggregator map pins, locality centers, road intersection pins, office addresses and unmapped acreage estimates.
Bossier MVK-2025-00855 coordinates or embedded georeferencing; those describe a different parish and park.
The current caddo-res41.pdf drawing-free template names Resilient Technology Park/Dawson Road/Greenwood Road only, not State Line; media upload date June 4 is not proof of passage or construction.
Blanchard Resolution 11 authorizes a service agreement but the unnamed customer and separate annexation items do not establish campus land.
Public speakers' unverified claims and requested moratorium language are not official physical observations or proof of a stop order.

successor_review.result: No authoritative actual completion or cancellation successor found through the cutoff in this bounded search. This does not close the missing site-identity/geometry gate.

checks.finding: Explicit August 18 update retains Caddo and Bossier while adding a third planned Shreveport campus and identifying STACK across all three. It reports no Caddo completion or cancellation. Investment and future operations do not refresh physical status.

The substitute motion to advance Resolutions 52/53 fails 3-8, and the original motion remanding both to the Special Projects Committee passes. The record is not an enacted moratorium or campus cancellation. Legal interpretations are attributed to the parish attorney, not independently asserted here.

Full-document text screen finds no campus completion, cancellation or moratorium enactment. The sole data-center item is administration's provision of a hyperscale definition. The later publication is retained distinctly from the August 20 meeting; it is not a new physical observation.

successor_review.exclusions: Post-August-20 policy developments and later page retrievals do not change the lifecycle reference date. No exhaustive permit/occupancy audit is claimed.

matches.name: STACK Bossier Highway 3 Technology Park Campus
matches.explanation: STACK is shared, but known Bossier campus is excluded from this candidate.

duplicate_screen.reason: No defensible Caddo geometry exists in this handoff to compare. Once a locator is established, compare all current full Point/Polygon/MultiPolygon geometries and aliases; no distance or non-overlap is invented.

visual_review.method: Read-only PDF inspection; full relevant pages rendered with Poppler to JPEG and inspected without cropping. Text extraction used for routing and full-document search, not as layout proof.
visual_review.not_claimed: No current aerial, satellite, site visit or imagery verification; no PDF geometries derived.

rights.stack_rights_note: Prior capture research records terms denial; not retried or bypassed. Corporate material treated as reserved-rights.
rights.policy: Compact factual projections, URLs and custody metadata only. No license inferred from public availability or government hosting; no third-party drawings, HTML, photographs, PDF pages, maps, signatures or unrelated personal testimony redistributed. Raw captures and rendered pages remain ignored local custody.

capture_method: Credential-free single Node fetch per new URL, 30-second timeout, no retries or overwrites. Hashes cover exact saved content-decoded bytes. Existing STACK/Amazon captures reused and rehashed. No authentication, hidden endpoint exploitation, forms bypass or remote mutation.

next_required_evidence.missing: The meeting specifically records the permit-information request as still outstanding. A publishable public response or recorded site plan is needed; this agent did not submit requests.
